title: Stop Crossing Your Arms When Steering
hook: Stop crossing your arms while steering.

script.narration: Stop crossing your arms while steering.
script.visual_search: driver hands crossing on steering wheel

script.narration: If an airbag deploys while your arms are crossed over the center of the wheel, it will violently slam your own hands and forearms directly into your face. Instead, use the push-pull method to keep your hands firmly on the outside edges.
